subject: Forrester request: NorthBay Health case spotlight — consent & scheduling
messages:
From: Megan Ortiz <megan.ortiz@forrester.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forrester request: can NorthBay join a short case spotlight?

Hi Soojin,

Forrester is compiling a short customer spotlight on inference economics and operational patterns for a vendor report being published next month. NorthBay Health came up repeatedly in our research as a strong example of cost-focused deployment and high-availability architecture. Would NorthBay be open to a 30-minute phone call with a Forrester analyst to discuss their deployment story, cost controls, and outcomes?

We typically ask customers for:
- 20–30 minutes on background and metrics (cost per infer, latency SLOs, availability)
- Permission to attribute a one-paragraph case blurb in the report
- Signed consent for the quote/usage in Forrester materials

If possible, could you share a suggested technical contact at NorthBay and whether Redwood can introduce the consent form ahead of time? Looking to schedule something between Aug 17–21.

Thanks,
Megan Ortiz
Senior Analyst, Forrester Research
megan.ortiz@forrester.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: none
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Forrester request: can NorthBay join a short case spotlight?

Hi Megan,

Thanks for the note — great to hear NorthBay surfaced in your research. NorthBay has agreed in principle to participate as a short customer spotlight and James Liu (VP Engineering) is the best point of contact. I will introduce you both and share a short consent form and a one-paragraph blurb for approval.

Planned next steps from Redwood:
1) Send James the consent form and a draft blurb for sign-off (attached).
2) Coordinate a single 30-minute slot in the Aug 17–21 window — James prefers mornings PT.
3) Share any specific data points or questions you want us to prep James on (e.g., unit economics, rollout timeline, SLA targets).

I've attached the consent PDF and a draft case blurb for James to review. Marissa will lead the customer outreach; Stephanie will handle logistics and DocuSign.

Would you like the call to be recorded? Forrester recordings are fine with NorthBay as long as they approve the final quote.

Best,
Soohin Lee
Head, Customer Advocacy | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 415 555 0199

Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Quick ask: Forrester spotlight — consent and a 30-min chat

Hi James,

Following up from Soojin — Forrester would like to do a short 30-minute customer spotlight about NorthBay's experience with Redwood Inference. We want to make this as low-touch as possible.

What we'd ask from you:
- 30-minute call (technical + outcomes): typical agenda is deployment overview (10 min), cost/economics (10 min), lessons/metrics (10 min).
- Permission to attribute a short paragraph in Forrester's report and use a brief quote. You will get final sign-off on the exact wording.
- Signature on the attached consent form (we can handle signing via DocuSign).

Available times (PT):
- Tue, Aug 18 — 9:00–9:30, 10:30–11:00
- Wed, Aug 19 — 8:30–9:00, 11:00–11:30
- Thu, Aug 20 — 9:00–9:30

If none of these work I can pull more slots. Also please confirm whether it's OK for the call to be recorded for Forrester's internal transcription — we'll only publish quotes after your approval.

Thanks so much, James — appreciate your help here.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
Customer Advocacy Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0144

Attachments: northbay-consent-form.pdf
From: James Liu <james.liu@northbayhealth.org>

Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: Forrester spotlight — consent and a 30-min chat

Marissa — thanks for the clear note and for sending the consent form. We're happy to participate.

Confirming: I'm available Aug 19 at 11:00–11:30 PT. The agenda looks good; I'll have our lead SRE (Anya Patel) join on the technical side. We're fine with a recording for transcription purposes as long as any direct quotes are run by us before publication.

I've signed the attached consent in DocuSign (you should see the completed envelope). For the blurb, please keep the quote factual — e.g., reference reduced per-inference cost and improved 99th percentile latency. We'll review the final wording.

Quick answers to expected questions:
- Cost metric: ~0.35 USD per 1k tokens processed after batching and caching optimizations (we can share a sanitized summary on the call).
- SLA target: 99.9% for our patient-facing inference endpoints; we run a multi-region fallback.

Look forward to the call — James

James Liu
VP, Engineering | NorthBay Health
